title: Cinematic landscape
subject: As described in the prompt
reverse_engineered_prompt: Create a cinematic wide landscape at sunset, with layered mountain ridges receding into the distance and a single solitary figure in silhouette on a rocky foreground. Place the figure slightly right of center and let the glowing peach sun illuminate the horizon. Use a restrained palette of dusty rose, muted violet, warm amber, and deep navy. Add atmospheric perspective, subtle haze, detailed terrain, dramatic but natural sky gradients, and filmic color grading. Preserve generous negative space and a strong sense of scale. No text, logos, or watermark. 4:3 landscape composition.
